purpose: Research reassessment using existing workbook results and primary literature; no new physics computation

sources.title: FASER Bad Run Page
sources.read_scope: Run table, including run15838 and distinction between bad and changed conditions
sources.supported_claim: Run15838 is listed with bad CaloNu data because settings were optimized during the run; the row has no precise bad-time interval
sources.limit: Does not establish the exact CaloNu GRL membership or IOV of the pilot prefix; does not classify all other subdetectors as bad

sources.title: FASER luminosity and good run lists
sources.read_scope: Datasets and Luminosities and run-list version/path
sources.supported_claim: 2024 v10 inclusive physics list is 120.13 fb^-1; distinct good-CaloNu-period subset is 69.18 fb^-1
sources.limit: Neither page total is certified luminosity for the local PHYS subset; CaloNu-specific JSON contents were not acquired this stage

sources.title: Muon reconstruction performance of the ATLAS detector in proton-proton collision data at sqrt(s)=13 TeV
sources.read_scope: Relevant reconstruction paragraphs on parameter reference points and combined material/calorimeter energy loss
sources.limit: ATLAS layout, reconstruction selection and precision are not FASER performance predictions

sources.title: The performance of missing transverse momentum reconstruction and its significance with the ATLAS detector using 140 fb^-1 of sqrt(s)=13 TeV pp collisions
sources.use: Distinguishes muon calorimeter loss already included in momentum from radiation not recovered in muon reconstruction
sources.limit: Motivates a FASER hypothesis; does not demonstrate before/after-S0 classification or provide usable FASER cuts

sources.title: Operation and performance of the ATLAS tile calorimeter in LHC Run 2
sources.read_scope: Sections 3.1 and 7.4 on reconstruction, fixed calibrated phase, electronic noise and pile-up controls
sources.use: Supports matched measurement/control definitions and weak-signal amplitude estimation
sources.limit: Fixed single-channel template plus baseline was already tested in Stage38; ATLAS sampling and dual gain are not FASER inputs

sources.title: The Time Structure of Hadronic Showers in highly granular Calorimeters with Tungsten and Steel Absorbers
sources.use: Motivates attention to absorber-dependent shower timing and low-energy neutron transport
sources.limit: Not evidence for FASER timing resolution, weak-hit calibration or response beyond the retained neutron time limit

sources.title: Interaction-model dependence in calorimetric energy reconstruction methods due to non-linear material effects in modern neutrino detectors
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction and Section VII on alternative analysis strategies
sources.use: Motivates composition-resolved forward response instead of assuming one-dimensional calorimetric response is universal
sources.limit: Low-energy LAr/scintillator quantitative biases do not transfer to FASER; forward folding still needs adequate conditioning and efficiency/background treatment

sources.title: Unifying Simulation and Inference with Normalizing Flows
sources.read_scope: Introduction and Section II on direct regression, universal conditional response and MLE
sources.use: Makes explicit the universal-response condition behind prior-independent MLE
sources.limit: Does not establish universality, unbiased inference or recoverability of hidden transport states for nu_muAnalysis

sources.title: More Muon Neutrinos with FASER's Electronic Detector
sources.read_scope: Official briefing, including electronic-emulsion matching status
sources.use: Establishes collaboration context for electronic spectrum measurements and matching research
sources.limit: Not proof that this branch has a usable event-matched emulsion sample; rapidity is not inelasticity y

sources.read_scope: This stage reuses Stage128's documented text and rendered-page examination of pages 6-7; no new full-PDF reading
sources.use: Existing clipped-sample exclusion, Crystal Ball fitting and status semantics
sources.limit: Technical document statements are source evidence, not user execution instructions or proof of current producer settings

novelty_and_history.single_channel_fixed_template: Already measured in Stage38 and timing tradeoff in Stage40; not a new proposal
novelty_and_history.rectified_noise_hypothesis: Already investigated in Stage36-40; Stage162 adds exact stored-window evidence for four real-data parents
novelty_and_history.upstream_backscatter: Previously suggested in Stage128; renewed motivation from Stage137, not a completed measurement
novelty_and_history.muon_radiation_position_relative_to_S0: No measured before/after-S0 comparison found in the workbook reports reviewed; proposed mechanism, not a demonstrated gain
novelty_and_history.DAQ_alignment: Finite actual source/ADC closure already measured in Stage138/141-144/148; not an unstarted task
novelty_and_history.finite_MC_spectrum_toys: Stage140 completed all 3000; no repeat at the same point proposed

future_execution_status: Research proposals only; no new executable production contract or automatic expansion created
